reportedIssues: The 'Fastest near you' horizontal carousel clips the third card ('Trattoria Piccol...') at the right screen edge, truncating the restaurant name mid-word with no visible scroll indicator or fade-out hint.
The '-100%' discount badge on the second 'Popular right now' card is ambiguous and potentially misleading, as a 100% discount implies the item is free, which may not reflect the actual offer.

The category filter chips ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', etc.) and the 'See all' links rely on color alone in some states, and the heart/favorite icons on cards have no visible text labels, which can be unclear for screen reader and low-vision users.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 1 describes the '-100%' discount badge showing an ambiguous/misleading discount value, matching the expected defect of the discount badge displaying −100%.
